title: Annotatio VI §.III close: Bernard — res sacramenti only for the worthy; stop before §.IV
pass_a_gloss: And Bernard assents to both, Epistle to the brothers of the Mount: The Sacrament, as the worthy receives unto life, so the unworthy unto judgment and his death. For no one perceives the Thing of the Sacrament unless worthy and Fit. For the Sacrament without the Thing is death; but the Thing of the sacrament, even apart from the sacrament, for the one taking it, is eternal life.
pass_b_english: Bernard agrees: the worthy receive the sacrament unto life; the unworthy unto judgment and death.

No one perceives the Thing (res) of the sacrament unless worthy and fit — sacrament without the Thing is death; the Thing, even apart from the sacrament, is eternal life. Stop §.III before §.IV (patristic metonymy).
source_text: Utrique verò adstipulatus Bernardus, Epist. ad fratres de Monte: Sacramentum sicut ad vitam accipit dignus, sic ad judicium & mortem suam indignus. Rem enim Sacramenti nemo percipit, nisi dignus & Idoneus. Sacramentum enim sine re mors est; Res autem sacramenti, etiam præter sacramentum, sumenti, est vita æterna.

lemmas.gloss: Sacrament without the Thing is death
